placements.lesson_title: Number Families & the Real Number System
The Real Number System & Interval Representations
The Imaginary Unit & Powers of i

factors-and-multiples.title: Factor Structure Lab

placements.lesson_title: Optimization with Perimeter and Area Constraints

factors-and-multiples.scope_note: GCF/LCM is intentionally reserved for the existing Pre-Algebra U01-L04 game to avoid subject duplication.

prime-spy-composite.title: Prime Spy / Composite Catch
prime-spy-composite.scope_note: Geometry and Algebra II Rational Root placements were deliberately not duplicated because those lessons already have canonical shared-game companions.

gcf-lcm-challenge.title: GCF / LCM Challenge

placements.lesson_title: Greatest Common Factor & Least Common Multiple

gcf-lcm-challenge.scope_note: Geometry uses LCM only as a rotational-cycle application. Algebra I extends GCF to monomials; Algebra II extends LCM to least common denominators. No duplicate game is created.

operation-stepper.title: Operation Stepper
operation-stepper.scope_note: The shared game teaches evaluation sequence. Higher modes use formula and composition structure rather than merely larger arithmetic.

estimate-defender.title: Estimate Defender

placements.lesson_title: Precision, Rounding, Significant Figures & Percent Error

estimate-defender.scope_note: Algebra II measurement-error and modelling lessons remain available for later companions; this game owns the strongest direct progression without duplicating those future concepts.

integer-compass.title: Integer Compass
integer-compass.scope_note: Progression is signed quantity → signed rate/slope → translation vector → vector components. Integer operation games remain separate to avoid duplication.

integer-rank.title: Integer Rank

placements.lesson_title: Inequality Meaning, Number Lines & Interval Notation

integer-rank.scope_note: Integer Rank owns order/interval representation and feasibility boundaries. Absolute-value solving remains with Opposite Mirror; later function-domain or inequality-solving games should extend other concepts rather than duplicate this ordering layer.

integer-sum-lab.title: Integer Sum Lab
integer-sum-lab.scope_note: Geometry is intentionally not assigned: Integer Compass already owns signed-coordinate/vector progression there. Algebra I polynomial addition remains available for a later polynomial-specific game, avoiding duplicate subject ownership.

opposite-shift.title: Opposite Shift
opposite-shift.scope_note: Geometry intentionally omitted: Integer Compass already owns signed-coordinate/vector progression. Complex subtraction remains with the complex-operations lesson family rather than duplicating Integer Sum Lab.

dividing-integers.title: Quotient Check · Dividing Integers
dividing-integers.scope_note: This game owns quotient structure, inverse verification, and divisor/denominator restrictions. Geometry is intentionally omitted because ratio, similarity, scale, and trigonometric-ratio progressions belong to later proportional-reasoning games. Sign Forge retains multiplication/division of rational expressions so subject ownership does not overlap.

coordinated-mission-control.title: Coordinated Mission Control
coordinated-mission-control.scope_note: Integer Compass already owns Geometry U02-L01 and Algebra II U10-L10. Coordinated Mission Control is intentionally assigned to later coordinate, slope, and multi-step navigation lessons to avoid duplicate subject ownership.

equation-balance-lab.title: Equation Balance Lab

placements.lesson_title: Multi-Step Equations with Distribution & Like Terms

equation-balance-lab.scope_note: Game v1 does not interpret mode parameters; learner selects difficulty manually. Pre-Algebra L02/L03 should use Level 1; L04 Level 2; L05 Level 3 (variables on both sides is advanced enrichment). Browser QA pending.

inequality-number-line.title: Inequality Number Line

placements.lesson_title: Inequality Meaning, Number Lines & Interval Notation

inequality-number-line.scope_note: Single-boundary inequalities only; compound and systems lessons intentionally excluded. Mode query is metadata; game v1 requires manual level selection. Browser QA pending.

slope-and-rate-studio.title: Slope & Rate Studio

placements.lesson_title: Rate of Change from Tables, Graphs & Contexts

slope-and-rate-studio.scope_note: Game reads mode query and selects initial level. Lessons include broader content beyond game's practice scope. Browser QA pending; no automatic course mastery writeback.

linear-systems-mission.title: Linear Systems Mission

placements.lesson_title: Systems as Intersections & Number of Solutions

linear-systems-mission.scope_note: Graph/intersection, substitution, elimination, and classification supported. Systems of inequalities and optimization excluded. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

polynomial-factoring-forge.title: Polynomial Factoring Forge
polynomial-factoring-forge.scope_note: Supports binomial expansion, monic/nonmonic quadratic factoring and zero-product solving; does not fully cover difference of squares, polynomial modelling or graph analysis. Browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

quadratic-graph-lab.title: Quadratic Graph Lab
quadratic-graph-lab.scope_note: Covers vertices, symmetry, roots, and transformations. Unit 10 Lesson 07 is supplemental only; game does not teach full projectile modelling or optimization. Browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

proof-path-builder.title: Proof Path Builder

placements.lesson_title: Parallel Lines Cut by a Transversal
Proving Lines Parallel from Angle Relationships

proof-path-builder.scope_note: Guided proof steps for angles, triangle congruence, parallel lines, and proof logic. Not an unrestricted proof editor; individual lessons may include theorems beyond this game. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.
